title: Cutting a Cake Nobody Envies
strategies: trivial: give every agent an identical 1/n fraction of every item (always envy-free, checker's own baseline)
greedy welfare-max: assign each item wholly to whichever agent values it most, ignoring fairness entirely (achieves the unconstrained welfare ceiling but is envy-free only by accident)

strong certified search: formulate envy-freeness as a linear system of pairwise value inequalities and directly solve the linear program 'maximize welfare subject to all envy constraints + feasibility', exploiting fractional divisibility to split contested items instead of awarding them whole
